chapters.title: Release, Observe, and Change the Model

figures.alt: One Mosaic case crosses interface, retrieval, model, validation, human gate, and minimized-signal checkpoints without granting the model decision authority.
figures.evidenceRole: Integrates the behavior path and minimized observation without reporting live traffic or quality.

figures.alt: Current and candidate model adapters cross the same frozen replay bridge, with a shadow lane, changed-limit records, and a rollback path to the qualified current adapter.
figures.evidenceRole: Explains reversible migration replay and the Volume 2 handoff without claiming migration success.

limitations: Mosaic Desk release candidates, signals, durations, incidents, migration results, and dispositions are fictional and synthetic.
The service-adapter fixture validates a semantic seam and responsibility records; it proves no provider equivalence, serving reliability, or security sufficiency.
The readiness fixture remains held for named-authority review and does not approve privacy, security, domain, platform, or production progression.
The migration fixture demonstrates replay, layered diagnosis, rollback, and changed-limit mechanics; it reports no live language quality, latency, or provider outcome.
The adaptation referral is deliberately not justified and transfers no training authority to Volume 2.
Figure records are semantic anchors only; root owns ImageGen production.
